proof_attempt_summary: Three D0 solve rounds derived a sound all-procedure lower edge of order d_n²/[n log(d_n+1)], a legal one-shot seed design with a deterministic d_n²/n risk certificate, and finite confidence guarantees. The matched frontier collapsed at the original Boolean radius-two operator/covariance bound: fixed-shape concentration and adjacency-polynomial tools do not control its unbounded collision expansion uniformly for 3≤d_n=o(√n). A future retry should reuse the lower bound and seed/Schur certificate and supply genuinely new control of that operator, rather than re-deriving the logarithmic bracket.
tldr: For every admissible degree sequence and all sufficiently large \(n\), the graph-selected one-shot seed procedure gives the deterministic certified upper edge \(R(G)\le C d_n^2/n\) on every simple \(d_n\)-regular graph \(G\). Under the uniform simple random-regular draw, the balanced-exposure converse gives \(R(G_n)\ge c d_n^2/[n\log(d_n+1)]\) with probability tending to one, so the joint bracket is a corollary. Bounded degrees yield \(R(G_n)=\Theta_{\Pr}(n^{-1})\); diverging degrees leave a factor \(\log(d_n+1)\) between the proved edges. The selected procedure also gives finite conditional coverage and unconditional radius \(O(d_n/\sqrt{\alpha n})=o(1)\) for fixed \(\alpha\). A sharper logarithmic upper edge and radius remain conditional on the unresolved Boolean radius-two operator conjecture.
gap: KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax, Corollary 5.4, leaves \(d_n/n\lesssim R(G_n)\lesssim d_n^2/n\) for the identical random-regular full-GATE problem, a polynomial factor-\(d_n\) gap. Existing cluster and conflict-graph designs do not supply a matching all-procedure converse or exploit balanced two-arm endpoint revelation.
fill: The proposal characterizes the balanced-packing scale using direct uniform-simple switchings below the verified sandwich threshold and monotone coupling above it, converts that scale to an all-design Bayes lower bound, and matches it with a graph-measurable seed design whose covariance has an exact Schur-power representation. A branch-safe finite compiler avoids undefined exposure ratios, and a centered Boolean collision theorem closes the only remaining upper-bound step before the graph certificate yields finite-sample coverage.
